description: This header file defines utilities for creating and working with seed sequences in the Abseil C++ library, including the `absl::SeedSeq` class, functions to create seed sequences from bit generators, and a function to generate a seed sequence with entropy salting.

classes.name: absl::SeedSeq
classes.description: A salted seed sequence class used for generating seeds with additional entropy, conforming to [rand.req.seedseq].

methods.name: absl::CreateSeedSeqFrom
methods.description: Creates a seed sequence from a given bit generator, extracting seed material to initialize the sequence.

methods.name: absl::MakeSeedSeq
methods.description: Generates a seed sequence with implementation-defined entropy salting for use in creating non-deterministic or correlated seed sequences.
